title: Democrat Motion to Block US-Israel Military Cooperation Legislation Fails in Congress
detail: A Democratic lawmaker's motion to block US legislation that would deepen military cooperation with Israel failed in a congressional vote on June 4, 2026. The measure aimed to restrict expanded arms and intelligence-sharing provisions in the bill, but was defeated, allowing the legislation to advance. The vote reflects continued bipartisan support in Congress for deepening security ties with Israel despite ongoing international criticism over the Gaza conflict.

media.caption: Democrat motion to block US-Israel military cooperation bill defeated in Congress
